title: Phonemes and Phonology
summary: Phonology studies how sounds are organised into meaningful units.

key_concepts.explanation: The smallest sound unit that distinguishes meaning.
Two words that differ in only one sound.

outline.heading: Phonemes and allophones

Speakers still hear both as one phoneme.
